purpose: Teach: 倭/弌/丙/鉉/辺野古/住専/フジサンケイビジネスアイ/日本経済新聞社
target_vocab: フジサンケイビジネスアイ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、古代の倭、つまり倭国の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper covered the history of ancient Wa — the Wa state, correct?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Slight upward inflection on the confirmation, genuinely interested. Professional but approachable — the teacher who actually read the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧字「弌」、つまり一の用法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, that's right. I focused on the usage patterns of the old character form for 'one' — the kanji 弌.
lines.style: Clear and precise. Respectful without being stiff. Slightly proud of the specific focus. Direct eye contact, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 武家の丙、つまり丙等級の制度研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper examined the ranking systems of the samurai class — the hei grades specifically, if I remember correctly?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuinely checking her own memory. Warm curiosity, not testing. The tone of someone who wants to make sure she has it right.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、漢字の鉉、つまり鉉の鼎の取っ手の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, exactly. I researched the handles of ancient bronze tripods — the xuan, and how they were used.
lines.style: Steady and clear. Pleased that she understood correctly. Speaking with quiet authority about her own work. Confident but not performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 辺野古の基地問題の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your next paper looked at the social dimensions of the Henoko base issue, if I'm not mistaken?
lines.style: Reflective and careful. Slightly cautious tone — acknowledging a more contemporary, sensitive topic. Still warm. Genuine curiosity about how the student approached it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、住専、つまり住宅専門金融の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the history and economics of the jusen — the housing finance institutions that shaped that era.
lines.style: Grounded and specific. Matter-of-fact delivery. Speaking about her research like someone who knows the material well. Respectful of the topic's complexity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: フジサンケイビジネスアイのアーカイブ研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And I see you also worked with archived materials from Fuji Sankei Business Eye — quite a deep dive into primary sources.
lines.style: Appreciative, noticing the methodological rigor. Warm acknowledgment of research depth. Slight upward tilt at the end — impressed without being effusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、日本経済新聞社のデータベース活用研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on how the Nikkei newspaper database could be used more effectively for research like mine.
lines.style: Concluding thought. Clear, accomplished. A student summing up their work to someone who genuinely understands it. Quiet confidence. Slight sense of closure.
